material.head: A* setup: wave 2 of wave 3
material.text: Five clean waves up from Nov 14, 2025 to May 28 (+326%, wave 1). The pullback is under the 0.618–0.786 zone of that advance (+46% to +10%), on lighter volume, with the 200-day average and the 50-week average in the same place. It is the second wave of a larger wave 3: five waves up from Apr 4, 2025 to Oct 15, 2025 and a pullback of 0.77 of them to the Nov 14, 2025 low came first, so the end of this wave 2 starts wave 3 of 3, the strongest move a chart makes. The count is wrong under the start of wave 1 (−35%); a close over the wave-1 high (+177%) says wave 3 is under way.
material.learn: After five waves up the pullback usually ends between the 0.618 and 0.786 retracement of the advance; a close turning up there is the buy.
